checks: Archive audit reads every outer ZIP member, validates CRC/content identity and safe unique unencrypted paths, refuses symlink entries, checks nested NPZ CRC and numeric NPY headers/storage sizes plus exact record array references; external inventory and internal MANIFEST are compared separately.
Credential signature findings emit only member/line/type, not potential secret contents; signature check limits are stated. Container checks do not claim numerical attention semantics.

Packaged bytes are tied by namespace to fixed Git content, inherited Beauty anchor, original job export manifests, exact external receipts and applied rule bytes; canonical six conditions times four batches require all24 raw NPZ.

Snapshot audit verifies exact canonical manifest digest, complete regular tar member set, all source bytes vs original fixed commit, and unchanged runtime Python against optional published commit, while separately reporting later non-Python differences.

Jobs audit checks actual original export sets and every hash, accepted canonical request, terminal cleanup/ownership flags, physical GPU UUID/caps, invocation/deployment identity and formal-result identities; it preserves known failed callback/preflight evidence.
Budget sum uses conservative original status intervals including cleanup and distinguishes requested timeout cap sums from measured utilization; it does not make a fresh process-state claim.
All four programs perform local read-only evidence/Git reads plus own report writes; no model construction, GPU calls, submit/restart/kill or Git mutation.
scope_limit: Source-only nonauthor review of the delivery reviewer programs; the /root/delivery_audit agent must execute them against actual final archive/publication/original records. This receipt does not accept an unbuilt ZIP or claim remote readback.
